arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Harrington stated that any new trial hearing tests verdict validity.
Mr. Shanmugam cited McDonough v. Greenwood to support his position.
Ms. Birnbaum argued that Rule 606 language is clear and limiting.
Justice Alito asked if receiving such testimony would be permissible.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the scope of Rule 606. This rule limits evidence used to challenge a verdict. the side that brought the case argues dishonesty at voir dire always warrants a new trial. the opposing side argues the rule bars such evidence unless it affects the verdict.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the limits of challenging jury verdicts. It determines when juror statements can overturn a trial. The outcome affects the finality of civil judgments. It shapes how courts handle juror credibility issues.
